notes.title: Patch Notes for 8/18/2023
notes.notes:
Thank you all for the feedback.  Here is a list of the changes made. Most importantly the boss has been changed. Also added more sound to make it easier to know what is happening.

[b][SOUND][/b]
[list]
[*] Added a lock sound when hitting the shop lock button
[*] Added a ultimate charged sound
[*] Added a sound when a crate drops
[/list]

[b][UI][/b]
[list]
[*] Added a replace weapon popup in the shop when you have 5 weapons instead of needing to manually destroy them
[*] Fixed bug where you weren't able to lock in the shop on rounds 9 and 19
[/list]

[b][GAMEPLAY][/b]

[list]
[*] Increased the wait time on the charge for the boss.
[*] Added spawning of creep enemies on the boss level
[/list]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the crate drop rates based upon difficulty (0.015, 0.0125, 0.01)
[*] Added showing the crate drops in combat text
[/list]
[list]
[*] Increased the charge energy required for the thrust ultimate to be equal to the slow ultimate.  Per difficulty - (10400, 11700, 13000)
[/list]
[list]
[*] Added more knockback to the shield aura. Also increased the area and the force of that knockback
[*] Fixed bug where the shield was removing too much energy on hit
[*] Modified the amount of hits blocked for the different levels of the shield (5,6,7,8)
[/list]
[list]
[*] Added armor penetration to the boss and its all of its attacks. Armor penetration is based upon difficulty (.10, .15, .20)
[/list]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the crate color to make it easier to see
[/list]

[b][MISC][/b]

[list]
[*] Increased performance of combat text
[/list]
